summary: V2 Congelado (Frozen Projects) tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/9 pytest cases pass. Frontend: KPI 'Congelados' (blue), avance filter option, status modal (Congelar/Descongelar), frozen-indicator, and ProjectSlaConfig frozen-freq-input all present and working. One backend validation bug found on PUT /api/project-sla/config with frozen_notify_frequency_days=0 (silently normalized to 7 instead of returning 400).

minor.issue: Sending frozen_notify_frequency_days=0 should return 400 ('debe ser >= 1'), but the endpoint accepts it and persists 7. Root cause: `freq = int(payload.frozen_notify_frequency_days or 7)` — value 0 is falsy in Python so `or 7` short-circuits and the `if freq < 1` guard is never reached. Fix: `freq = int(payload.frozen_notify_frequency_days) if payload.frozen_notify_frequency_days is not None else 7` (Pydantic already coerces to int, so simply drop the `or 7` and rely on the model default; then keep the `if freq < 1` check). Values < 0 also currently pass silently for the same reason (e.g. -3 would be truthy and get through, but then `if freq < 1` catches negatives — however 0 slips through). File: /app/backend/routes/project_sla.py line 86-88.

issues: Requirements referenced testids as 'kpi-card-*' but actual implementation uses 'stat-congelados' / 'stat-value-congelados'. Functionality (blue color, count, click-to-filter) works correctly; only the testid naming diverges from spec. Consider aligning if external tests depend on the kpi-card-* prefix.

action_items: Fix validation of frozen_notify_frequency_days=0 on PUT /api/project-sla/config (drop `or 7` short-circuit so <1 is properly rejected).
Optional: align KPI testids on Projects page to 'kpi-card-*' as originally specified in the requirement (currently 'stat-congelados').
critical_code_review_comments: routes/projects.py is very large (~4667 lines); consider splitting freeze/unfreeze logic and the _dispatch_project_status_action helper into a dedicated module.

The freeze/unfreeze snapshot uses `int(project.get('sla_days') or 0)` which is fine, but `frozen_at` uses ISO string not datetime — consistent with the rest of the codebase but be aware timezone parsing is done via `.replace('Z','+00:00')` elsewhere.
In project_sla.py PUT config, use Pydantic validator (`Field(ge=1)`) for `frozen_notify_frequency_days` to enforce >=1 at parse time instead of manual `if freq < 1`.
